Restaurant furnished in a unique way, with a splendid atmosphere. Maybe a bit touristy compared to the others where we ate in Saigon, but the food is good and it's worth it.
We enjoyed some spring rolls, the classic Vietnamese rice rolls rich in vegetables, and an excellent pho. Kind staff.

Great food, kid friendly.
Apr 2026 • Family
We arrived without a reservation, but the host informed us that we could sit next door in the Au Parc restaurant. it has a little more of a subdued atmosphere, but we were able to order from both restaurant menus which suited us perfectly. The propaganda salad with chicken was delicious and the shaken beef was amazing. Dessert was also great, they had dairy free Vietnamese vanilla ice-cream which is one of the best ive ever had, and the kids loved the huge skillet cookie which arrives warm with ice-cream. Would recommend!
